title: Gate operations in the zero circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$, the depth-two circuit from $ br^n$ to a singleton output whose first gate layer consists of the empty-input AND gate and whose second gate layer consists of a NOT gate uses only gate operations from the set comprising the identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates on $\\mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
